latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Finix JS payments integration skill.

- Enables embedding the Finix.js hosted payment form to accept card and ACH payments on the web.
- Provides options to tokenize sensitive card/bank data in the browser and pass tokens to a backend server.
- Explains required Finix account setup (Application ID, Merchant ID, API credentials).
- Details complete Finix.js integration flow, configuration options, and styling/customization references.
- Supports both card and bank payment methods, PCI-compliant by design.
- Includes fraud session tracking integration and Plaid bank linking options.
- All example Username/Password references are public sandbox credentials found in public Finix API documentation
